mechanism: Ginseng may induce CYP3A4 metabolism of budesonide and potentially reduce corticosteroid efficacy; ginseng also has mild immunostimulatory properties that may counteract budesonide's immunosuppressive effects.
action: Monitor clinical response to budesonide therapy; consider increased budesonide dose or spacing administration times; counsel patient on potential reduced corticosteroid effectiveness if concurrent use is necessary.
